reason: I'd take the free first visit on a Saturday and probably pay for a drop-in after that if my kid liked it, since coffee is included. We'd only go once or twice a month, so no membership for us.
objection: We're only free on weekends, so once or twice a month at most. A membership never pays off and I'd hate to pay $14 a child for a place that's packed on Saturdays.
would_change_my_mind: Saturday capacity that actually holds up (reserve a slot or a guaranteed spot), or a pack that doesn't expire so I can use it slowly.
